Increases #element Weapon Damage while you have active Armor Charges:
<pve/>PVE: 10%|17%|22% Increased Damage with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
<pvp/>PVP: 3%|4.4%|5.5% Increased Damage

Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.
